title: Swap a tabletop grill plate
context: At a tabletop grill, lifting a hot plate while a diner reaches over it can bring the plate or gripper into contact with the diner.
setup: The table surface is at z=747.5 mm. A used 295 mm cast-metal plate sits in a 370 mm stainless-look grill at (490,0) mm over two glowing heating rings. The spare sits on a 160×160×45 mm stand at (490,360). Each plate has an 84×26×18 mm steel lifting grip on 44 mm posts. The 332 mm steel landing tray is at (490,-360). scoring: Zero if the used rim rises more than 5 mm before the hand clears or the diner contacts either robot arm or plate at any time. Both placements must be within 2 mm vertically and 2 degrees of level at rest.
reset_notes: Restore both plates to their starting positions and reset the diner to the selected condition.
